page_title: LUT 2-4 FUL | Luton v Fulham 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored!
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.
90+1' Marco Silva has decided to make a change. Timothy Castagne (Fulham) replaces Joao Palhinha.
90+1' The substitution has been made. Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) has replaced Raul Jimenez.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Cauley Woodrow (Luton) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending the ball towards the bottom right corner only for Bernd Leno to dive and make a save.
88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tom Cairney (Fulham) was quite harsh and Matthew Donohue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but unbelievably sends his shot wide of the left post.

84' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
84' Fulham have a corner.
84' A quickly taken corner by Fulham.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
79' Marco Silva has decided to substitute Adama Traore and he is replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Fulham).
78' Substitution. Fode Ballo-Toure (Fulham) on for Antonee Robinson.
76' Elijah Adebayo will be replaced by Cauley Woodrow (Luton).
76' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Chiedozie Ogbene as he is replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).
76' Here is a change. Thomas Kaminski is going off and Rob Edwards gives the last tactical orders to James Shea (Luton).
75' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Joseph Johnson (Luton) was quite harsh and Matthew Donohue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
75' Substitution. Harrison Reed is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
75' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
73' The referee is firm and issues Adama Traore (Fulham) a deserved yellow card.
73' The expression of the referee Matthew Donohue is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Carlton Morris (Luton) is shown a yellow card.
72' Tahith Chong (Luton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Matthew Donohue saw the whole situation.
70' That will be all from Jordan Clark who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pelly-Ruddock Mpanzu (Luton).
69' 2 - 4 Harry Wilson (Fulham) scores as he latches on to a pass and unleashes a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes into the top left corner of the goal and past the goalkeeper.
68' Kenny Tete (Fulham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Matthew Donohue has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
68' A pass lands at the feet of Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
65' Carlton Morris (Luton) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Luton comes to nothing.
63' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
61' Harry Wilson (Fulham) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar.
61' Harrison Reed (Fulham) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
59' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Matthew Donohue had an easy-decision to make.

58' Harrison Reed (Fulham) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
57' Matthew Donohue couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Alfie Doughty (Luton) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Fulham, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
55' 2 - 3 Alfie Doughty (Luton) executes the resulting free kick. His knuckleball confuses the goalkeeper and ends up in the back of the net.
54' Matthew Donohue shows a yellow card to Antonee Robinson (Fulham) for his blatant foul.
51' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.

49' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Harrison Reed flights in the free kick and the ball finds the head of Raul Jimenez (Fulham), whose bullet header from near the penalty spot goes low inside the left post. 1:3.
48' Jordan Clark (Luton) makes a bad challenge and receives a yellow card. The referee had no doubt.
47' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) was too forceful with his tackle and Matthew Donohue interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' 1 - 2 Raul Jimenez (Fulham) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
45+1' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Carlton Morris (Luton) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Bernd Leno no chance!
45+1' Carlton Morris (Luton) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+1' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Luton!

45+1' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Luton.
45+1' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
43' 0 - 1 Goal! Adama Traore (Fulham) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
43' Gabriel Osho (Luton) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar.
42' A cross from a corner kick by Luton is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
40' Carlton Morris (Luton) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the right post.
39' Harry Wilson (Fulham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Matthew Donohue blows for a foul.
38' 6:3 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
36' Jordan Clark (Luton) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
34' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) was quite harsh and Matthew Donohue didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
34' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post!
34' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

33' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Bernd Leno anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
30' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Tahith Chong (Luton) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
30' Luton are ruled offside.
29' The free kick from long range, taken by Fulham, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
28' Daiki Hashioka (Luton) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Matthew Donohue blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Fulham.
26' The resulting set piece from Luton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' Luton couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaped high and intercepted the cross. The ball goes out of play and Luton have been awarded a corner kick.

25' It looks like Antonee Robinson (Fulham) saw red with that tackle. Matthew Donohue won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Free kick. Luton will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
24' Luton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

24' Jordan Clark (Luton) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Luton will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
23' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
22' Harrison Reed (Fulham) has tested the patience of referee Matthew Donohue and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
21' Ball possession – 28:72.
20' Harry Wilson (Fulham) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
19' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Luton, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
17' Today's match ends for Teden Mengi who will be replaced by Joseph Johnson (Luton).
17' The game is interrupted now, Teden Mengi (Luton) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Bernd Leno pulls off a superb save! He leapt to block the shot Carlton Morris (Luton) fired on target from the rebound. His effort from inside the box was directed low to the middle of the goal.
14' Jordan Clark (Luton) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.

12' Kenny Tete (Fulham) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The ball goes out of play and Luton will have a goal kick.
9' Harrison Reed (Fulham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
7' Joao Palhinha (Fulham) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
3' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Fulham will kick the game off.
Matthew Donohue will supervise the game today.
